name: LoopForge
description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
one_liner: A control room for AI coding agents — it lets a team tell several different AI coders what to do, watch them work in sandboxes, and approve their changes before anything ships.
buyer: An engineering lead running multiple AI coding agents across a team who needs a single place to approve what they produce before it merges.
business_use_cases: A dev team runs nightly automated refactor jobs across several AI agents and only reviews the diffs each morning before approving.
An agency managing many client codebases uses it to standardize how every AI-driven code change gets human sign-off before merge.
A startup CTO lets non-engineers submit feature requests that get translated into AI-generated pull requests awaiting their approval.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed version with team seats and audit logging for compliance-conscious companies

steal_this: Spin up a hosted instance pre-wired to Claude Code and Codex, and market it to small dev teams as 'an AI dev team, with you as the only approver'.
